d:
Sachin tendulkar ko apna aadarsh manne vale bihar ke kaptan mangal kumar mahraur ne apne pahle hi ranji trophi maich men itihas racha tha. nagalaind ke khilaph 2018 men khele gae debyu mukable men unhonne 177 ranon ki shandar pari kheli, jo kisi bhi khilari dvara debyu maich men banaya gaya sarvadhik skor hai.
